messages:
lena-sales: Heads-up — Prospect (Harbor Financial) wants to run a 4-week POC. Requirements: SSO via SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC via groups, and domain enforcement for invites. Need a short runbook + pricing sketch.

omar-solutions: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP init). Ask for IdP metadata XML and cert. We can do persistent NameID (email) and transient. We support Assertion Signing (SHA256) and Audience Restriction. Do they require encrypted assertions?

lena-sales: Buyer prefers encrypted assertions and wants signed responses. Also wants the ability to map multiple IdP groups to a single Redwood role (e.g., "fin-team" + "auditors" -> "viewer").

nora-eng: Mapping is doable two ways: (1) include a SAML attribute redwood:groups with a comma list of group names, or (2) provision groups over SCIM and use Console mapping rules. For POC recommend SCIM groups -> role mapping so changes are immediate.

patrick-security: Security notes: we strongly prefer TLS1.2+, signatures SHA256. For SCIM tokens we recommend automated rotation every 90 days. Hosted supports OAuth bearer; Dedicated/Private can enable mTLS for SCIM. Also collect their ATO questionnaire answers.

omar-solutions: SCIM details: /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups implemented. Bulk create supports up to 100 users per request. PATCH for groups supported. Rate limit default: 12 req/s per tenant on Hosted.

lena-sales: Pricing question from buyer: what are the Hosted per-call costs vs Dedicated flat?

omar-solutions: Quick bullets I will draft: Hosted: small monthly base + per-active-user + per-1000-provisioning-calls; Dedicated: reserved capacity seat + provisioning allowance; excess provisioning calls billed. I'll add an example for 500 users.

nora-eng: Runbook items I'll include: ACS URL, SP entityID, sample attribute map, SCIM examples, group->role mapping snippet, and quick troubleshooting tips (SAML logs + SCIM 409/422 semantics).

patrick-security: Domain controls: we support DNS TXT verification and enforced email domain allowlists. For mixed orgs we support domain claim + admin approval flow. Also note: if they require IP allowlist for SCIM callbacks we can accept a list of CIDRs on Dedicated.

oncall-bot: [automated] Created ticket HARBOR-POC-1023 and attached SAML/SCIM checklist.

lena-sales: Action items: @nora-eng please produce the 1-pg runbook and small example snippets; @omar-solutions draft pricing bullets + sample calculator; @patrick-security fill the security questionnaire answers. Target: Tue EOD. I'll send to buyer once internal review done.

omar-solutions: ACK :thumbsup:

nora-eng: Adding minimal SCIM example for runbook:

```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "userName": "mturner@harbor.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Maya","familyName":"Turner"},
  "emails": [{"value":"mturner@harbor.com","primary":true}]
}
```

patrick-security: Sample SAML attribute snippet for role mapping:

```
<Attribute Name="redwood:role">
  <AttributeValue>viewer</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```

lena-sales: Great work team — will follow up after runbook + pricing ready.
